items.title: “The first day of training camp, LeBron was coming at me full speed,” Labaron Philon Jr. said. “I was backpedaling.”
items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
“The first day of training camp, LeBron was coming at me full speed,” Labaron Philon Jr. said. “I was backpedaling.”

That is when being in the NBA felt real, the rookie said. (He went for the strip, LeBron passed the ball.)

media.title: Sixers player preview: Labaron Philon Jr. aims to provide a spark in rookie season
media.description: When the Sixers selected LaBaron Philon Jr. at No. 22 overall in the 2026 NBA Draft, he seemed to have a clear path to a rotation role as a rookie. It is not as clear now.
